_note: Pose-keyed playback DEFAULTS (anim-playback epic E3, 86ca2187n) + pose-default SCENE block (scene-per-pose feature, 86ca88nvd). `playback`: keyed by canonical anim name, sets playback fields ONCE for ALL characters — e.g. `idle_stretch: { playbackMode: "pingpong", finalDwellMs: 800 }` makes every character's stretch ping-pong without a per-char edit. The cascade is 3-LAYER and FIELD-LEVEL: a character's own animations.json `playback.<anim>.<field>` wins; else this pose-default's `<field>`; else the engine default. Same field vocabulary + validation as animations.json `playback` (speedMultiplier, dwellFrameIndex, dwellMs, finalDwellMs, playbackMode, startFrame, endFrame); malformed values are dropped + warned by scripts/build-sprite-manifest.mjs. `scenes`: keyed by canonical anim name, value = a scene id (e.g. "room3") OR the literal "none" (flat card — STOPS the cascade); a key ABSENT inherits the manifest defaultSceneId (room3). The SEED below fixes the desk-clash: `active_work`/`active_read` bake their OWN desk into the sprite, so they get "none" (no room behind the desk → no double-desk); idle poses are absent → they inherit room3 via the default pointer. Per-char `animations.json` `scenes` overrides this layer. Edit + `npm run build` + reload to apply, no TS edit.
